subject: Weekly Exec Compact: Wins, Risks, and Focus for QBR Deck
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Weekly Exec Compact: Wins, Risks, and Focus for QBR Deck

Morning team — attaching a short compact for leadership ahead of the QBR dry-run Friday. High-level ask: please scan and reply with any additions by EOD so I can fold them into the one-pager and the slide intro.

Topline (2 lines each):
- Sales / GTM (Vanessa): closed + expansion motions this week; one late-stage renewal at risk pending security sign-off.
- Product / Platform (Karthik): serving runtime latency improved by 12% after kernel swap; one rollout paused for regression investigation.
- Partnerships / Strategic (Laura): Marketplace listing scheduled; raised partner co-sell motion with Acme.

Immediate risks (brief):
- Acme procurement hold until SOC evidence delivered (Procurement wants SOC2 report and audit window).
- Canary regression: 1% token-level accuracy drift on a small customer cohort — investigating root cause.

Asks (who / what / when):
- Vanessa: confirm renewal status with Acme by 12:00 PT (today).
- Karthik: short note on regression owner and action plan by 3pm.
- Laura: drop the Marketplace listing timeline into the Drive doc.

Attachments: QBR_one-pager_v2.pdf (one-pager summary), Acme-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan stub).

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake
Head of GTM Ops, Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference | redwood-inference.com

Subject: Re: Weekly Exec Compact: Wins, Risks, and Focus for QBR Deck

Jordan — quick update from Sales:
- Win: Closed a $75k ARR add-on with CloudBridge (Matt) — onboarding kickoff Monday.
- Risk: Acme renewal (Ellen) is still flagged; procurement asked for SOC documentation and a runbook of data flows. Ellen looped procurement; they want a point-by-point checklist.

Actionable: I pinged Matt at CloudBridge to request a short customer quote for the QBR (will add to Drive). For Acme, I'm on a 11:30 call with Ellen and procurement; I will confirm outcome by noon and post notes to the MAP.

Attachment: Acme-MAP-v1.xlsx updated with meeting time.

- Vanessa
VP, Revenue Operations

Thanks Vanessa — quick note from procurement: we received the SOC2 cover letter but need the evidence package plus expected audit window. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the SOC2 evidence report or an auditor contact? Also share your retention policy and how token logs are managed for customer isolation.

We can expedite once we have the evidence + a short data flow diagram. Thanks,

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly Exec Compact: Wins, Risks, and Focus for QBR Deck

Looping in the platform note:
- Win: Kernel swap for the nvlink-optimized path rolled out to 40% of capacity; median p95 latency improved 12% for 2k token prompts.
- Risk: During the rollout a small customer cohort (internal id: CB-47) is seeing a token-level scoring regression ~1%. Root cause looks like a quantization rounding edge-case when sequence padding interacts with newer attention kernel.

Plan by 3pm:
1) Halt canary expansion — done.
2) Revert affected nodes to prior kernel — in progress, ETA 2 hours.
3) Run targeted evals on affected prompts and add to the regression tracker (link below).

I'll add a short note to the QBR one-pager with the mitigation steps and decision lane.

Karthik
VP, Platform Engineering
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly Exec Compact: Wins, Risks, and Focus for QBR Deck

Thanks all — final notes:
- Vanessa: Acme procurement confirmed they will accept a SOC2 evidence package and a short data-flow slide; they asked for delivery by EOW. Please coordinate with Legal/Security to fast-track.
- Karthik: appreciate the rollback and the quick evals — add the exact mitigations to the Drive checklist.
- Laura: please confirm Marketplace listing date; if still on track, we add it as an upside in slides.

I've uploaded a cleaned one-pager (QBR_one-pager_v2.pdf) and left both the Drive link and HubSpot HS-98234 for the board packet. If no objections, I'll finalize the deck slides at 9:00am PT tomorrow and send for a 30-min dry run at 11:00am.

If anything changes after your EOD updates, reply-all.

Jordan
--
